title: Opposites attract.
old_caption:
One of you wants to go now, the other wants to think it over?
Aries and Libra show opposites can push, pull and still clink cups.

title: Orion's Ex Era.
old_caption: Flowers, a serenade, a disguise, and they keep running. Chasing someone who keeps saying no isn't romance. Love feels different when someone walks toward you too.

title: Too Much, Too Soon.
old_caption: Eager to be known on date one? That's sweet, and your story matters. But 87 slides is a lot for a first coffee. Share yourself in chapters and let them earn the next one.

title: Pirates of the Heart.
old_caption:
Captain Scorpio sails past abs, fool's gold and a ring light looking for the perfect partner. The real treasure was someone with tea on a rainy day.
Notice how they treat you on an ordinary day.

title: Pre-Game.
old_caption:
Last time they said no, and that still stings. Your squad wants you to know you're kind, funny and rare.
A no isn't a verdict on your worth. It's just not your match. Whatever happens tonight, you're doing great.

title: Previously On… Your Love Life.
old_caption: The late-night texts, the situationship, the season finale where you swore off love. Rough chapters happen. Your past is one season, not the whole series. There's more story ahead.

title: Mercury is retrograde.
old_caption:
Typing "hey stranger" to your ex during retrograde?
The whole zodiac says put the phone down. Use it for reflecting, not re-texting.

title: First impressions are your Rising.
old_caption:
Do you try on a different vibe every time you meet someone?
Your Rising is just the front door. Let them see the whole house.

title: Safety Demonstration.
old_caption:
This safety demo covers commitment that holds without trapping, dealbreakers as exits, and friends as life vests.
Put your own mask on first. Caring for yourself is how you love others well.

title: Turning 29? That's your Saturn return.
old_caption:
Turning 29 and dating the same mistake again?
Saturn says write your dealbreakers down. Your 30s are calling.
